title: Who owns what
sub: In the weeds of data crafting, a technical series for analytics engineers: domains own meaning and publish public, contracted, versioned core models; consumers build on those, not on each other's marts. Access says who can refer to a model; grants say who can read it; keys, the hash and conventions stay shared.
howto: White lines on blue are the model; code on dark glass is the project, and the small label beside it says where it runs. Three rings are dbt's access: private, protected, public. Doors are grants: who can read. Teal is an AI agent's work; gold is a person's approval.
